Game Overview

In Block Away, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in a strategic puzzle challenge where you tactically maneuver blocks through matching-colored walls. Exercise precision and foresight to clear the board, ensuring no collisions disrupt your carefully plotted path. Each level brings a new mind-bending conundrum; can you plan your way to victory?
